summary: HH Premium Visa Consulting is a Chiang Mai visa agency assisting with Thailand Privilege (Elite), LTR and retirement visas and related paperwork.

facts.label: Privilege visa fees
facts.value: No extra agency fee; the agency is paid commission by Thailand Privilege
facts.quote: There are no additional fees to work with us (we receive commission from Thailand Privilege)

facts.label: Privilege packages
facts.value: Privilege packages start at 650,000 THB for 5 years
facts.quote: Packages start at 5 years for 650,000 THB / $20,000 USD

facts.label: Retirement visa
facts.value: Retirement visa assistance only once you are in Thailand
facts.quote: We only provide retirement visa assistance once you're already in Thailand.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Based in Chiang Mai, Elite visa assistance done online nationwide
facts.quote: We are based in Chiang Mai but we offer Elite visa assistance throughout Thailand.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.value: Handles extensions, residency certificates, TM30 and 90-day reporting
facts.quote: handles essential government documents such as visa extensions, Residency Certificates, TM30s, and 90-day reporting
